title: Rejection Record (v1.0.0)
description: Record stored in the bronze.rejections table for every event rejected at the ingestion boundary (schema failure) or discarded as a duplicate (idempotency). See ADR-0001.

original_message.description: The original message as received, stored as-is (it already failed validation, so it is not further constrained).

reason.description: Why the event was rejected or discarded.

received_ts.description: UTC timestamp when the message was received by ingestion.
